uiDiagnosis: read-heavy-02: Explain selection drift and stale totals in the invoice table

reactDefects.statement: grandTotal reads taxRate but the memo dependency list contains only rows, so tax changes leave a stale total.
Rows use array indexes as keys; sorting or insertion can move component identity to another invoice.

evidenceMap.excerpt: const grandTotal = useMemo(() => rows.reduce((n,r) => n + r.total * (1 + taxRate), 0), [rows]);
